matrix.tone_rationale: Motivational and encouraging tones are essential to activate users during the trial phase.
Celebratory tones acknowledge user progress, while urgent mild tones encourage continued learning.
Friendly and informative tones aim to re-engage users without being too pushy.
Informative tones provide context, while urgent mild tones encourage reactivation.
